description: Strain-level annotation survey, genomic context, and InterPro domain truncation signature for HP_1507
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.0,1.0,1.0],width_ratios=[1.25,1.0],hspace=0.75,wspace=0.28)

# --- A: strain survey, annotated length ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
lens=pd.Series({399:375, 380:6, 317:1})
y=np.arange(len(lens))
cols=["#2b7a4b","#b5651d","#b5651d"]
ax.barh(y,[375,6,1],color=cols,height=0.6)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(["399 aa\nMHTVLQIGAGGVGS...","380 aa\nMGMNRDVFKNII...","317 aa\nMALPYQDLTIM..."],fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate([375,6,1]):
    ax.text(v+6,i,f"{v}  ({100*v/382:.1f}%)",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,460); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("number of H. pylori genome annotations",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A. HP_1507 orthologs in 382 H. pylori genome annotations\n"
             "(400-record RefSeq/ENA sample; 0 reproduce the 385-aa O26037 start)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- B: N-terminal 16-mer counts ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
nt=[("MHTVLQIGAGGVGSVV",362),("MGMNRDVFKNIILASR",6),("MHTVLQIGAGGVGGVV",4),
    ("MYTVLQIGAGGVGSVV",2),("MHTVLQIGAGGIGSVV",2),("MHTVLQIGAGGVGSVA",2),
    ("other GxGxxG-containing",3),("MALPYQDLTIMQACLE",1)]
y=np.arange(len(nt))
cols=["#b5651d" if ("MGMNRD" in s or "MALPYQ" in s) else "#2b7a4b" for s,_ in nt]
ax.barh(y,[c for _,c in nt],color=cols,height=0.6)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([s for s,_ in nt],fontsize=7.5,family="monospace")
for i,(s,c) in enumerate(nt): ax.text(c+5,i,str(c),va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,420); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("count",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("B. Annotated N-terminal 16-mers\n(green: contains the GxGxxG fingerprint)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- C: genomic context ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
ax.set_xlim(1578900,1581700); ax.set_ylim(-1.5,1.6)
def gene(a,b,strand,lab,col):
    w=b-a; hh=0.42
    if strand=="+":
        pts=[(a,-hh),(b-60,-hh),(b,0),(b-60,hh),(a,hh)]
    else:
        pts=[(b,-hh),(a+60,-hh),(a,0),(a+60,hh),(b,hh)]
    ax.add_patch(mp.Polygon(pts,fc=col,ec="0.25",lw=0.8))
    ax.text((a+b)/2,0,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="w",fontweight="bold")
gene(1578968,1580194,"-","HP_RS07455 / HP1506  gltS","#4a5568")
gene(1580280,1581479,"+","HP_RS07460 / HP1507  casdh (399 aa)","#2b7a4b")
gene(1581489,1581700,"-","HP1508 ccoG","#4a5568")
ax.plot([1580195,1580279],[0.75,0.75],color="#1f3f73",lw=2)
ax.text(1580237,0.95,"85 bp intergenic\n(divergent promoters)",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#1f3f73")
ax.plot([1580229],[0.55],marker="v",color="#8b1a1a",ms=7)
ax.text(1580229,0.3,"in-frame TAA\n1580229",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,color="#8b1a1a")
ax.annotate("TTG 1580280\n(RefSeq PGAP start)",xy=(1580280,-0.45),xytext=(1579900,-1.15),fontsize=8,color="#14532d",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#14532d"))
ax.annotate("GTG 1580322\n(O26037 / AAD08549 start)",xy=(1580322,-0.45),xytext=(1580520,-1.2),fontsize=8,color="#b5651d",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#b5651d"))
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("NC_000915.1 / AE000511.1 coordinate",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("C. Genomic context: HP_1507 is divergent from gltS; the first in-frame upstream stop (TAA 1580229) lies in the intergenic region",
             fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- D: InterPro domain boundaries mapped onto 399-residue numbering ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:])
ax.set_xlim(-5,405); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,3.6)
tracks=[("H. mustelae D3UGV5 (399 aa)",0,(1,191),(1,134),(141,389)),
        ("H. cetorum I0ESJ2 (399 aa)",0,(2,190),(4,135),(141,392)),
        ("H. acinonychis Q17ZI8 (399 aa)",0,(2,190),(4,135),(141,392)),
        ("H. pylori 26695 O26037 (385 aa)",14,(15,176),(2,120),(127,378))]
for i,(lab,shift,ssf,pf1,pf2) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=i
    ax.plot([1+shift,399 if shift==0 else 385+shift],[y,y],color="0.8",lw=6,solid_capstyle="butt")
    ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((ssf[0]+shift,y-0.17),ssf[1]-ssf[0],0.34,fc="#9fc5e8",ec="none"))
    ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((pf1[0]+shift,y-0.12),pf1[1]-pf1[0],0.24,fc="#2b6cb0",ec="none"))
    ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((pf2[0]+shift,y-0.12),pf2[1]-pf2[0],0.24,fc="#c05621",ec="none"))
    col="#b5651d" if shift else "0.15"
    ax.text(-8,y,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8,color=col)
ax.axvspan(8,13,color="#2b7a4b",alpha=0.22)
ax.text(10.5,3.45,"GxGxxG",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#14532d")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("position in the 399-residue numbering (O26037 shifted by +14)",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("D. InterPro matches: in O26037 the PF03435 NADP-binding match starts 12 residues later and SSF51735 starts 27 residues later",
             fontsize=10,loc="left")
h=[mp.Patch(color="#9fc5e8",label="SSF51735 NAD(P)-binding Rossmann"),
   mp.Patch(color="#2b6cb0",label="PF03435 Sacchrp_dh_NADP"),
   mp.Patch(color="#c05621",label="PF16653 Sacchrp_dh_C")]
ax.legend(handles=h,fontsize=7.5,loc="lower right",frameon=False,ncol=3)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
